findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "make_wish" is 864 chars, far longer than this server's median (128). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Prepares a personalised video wish: Santa Claus, Mrs Claus, an elf, Saint Nicholas, the Three Kings, the Tooth Fairy, a birthday bear or another character says …

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_film, get_generation · Public sink: touch_up · Destructive: create_ad, touch_up.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_film, get_generation · Public sink: touch_up · Destructive: create_ad, touch_up

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
